img.caption: Figure 1: Overview of the proposed training-free framework. A query q is processed in three stages: (1) retrieval from a zero-annotation intent KB combined with LLM multi-intent reasoning, fused into a rank-normalized score s(q); (2) split conformal calibration on a set-level Jaccard risk that guarantees P(Y in S_hat(q)) >= 1-alpha; (3) an adaptive three-state decision (release / clarify / reject) calibrated at FPR95. No gradient training is required; LoRA/SetFit is shown only as an optional comparison.
